name: Alps Mountain Pass
description: A gruelling ascent through the Swiss Alps above Zermatt — tight hairpins cling to sheer granite walls while the Matterhorn looms ahead, rewarding brave braking with breathtaking vistas.

metadata.notes: Swiss Alps mountain pass with 15 hairpin bends climbing from Zermatt valley floor to summit. Supports clear, rain, and dusk weather.

dataAttribution: Procedurally generated — inspired by Swiss Alpine passes near Zermatt.
